subject.title: feat: bind signed ClawHub default feed trust

question: Should OpenClaw activate the built-in ClawHub feed under this permanent feed-ID, expiry, trust-root, and fail-closed contract once the producer and rotation dependencies are ready?
rationale: The code selects the marketplace content-trust boundary and operator-visible upgrade behavior; implementation tests cannot decide whether maintainers accept this production key ownership and fallback policy.

options.title: Approve after integrated proof
options.body: Keep the draft open, finalize the signer, RFC, and rotation dependencies, and require exact-head end-to-end proof before merge.

options.title: Limit to custom profiles
options.body: Merge only generic `feedId` binding for explicitly configured signed profiles and defer built-in ClawHub trust activation.

options.title: Pause signed default feeds
options.body: Do not proceed if the project is not ready to own a production marketplace signing root and its rotation operations.

recommendation.title: Approve after integrated proof
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open, finalize the signer, RFC, and rotation dependencies, and require exact-head end-to-end proof before merge.
